quest.title: Strength, Courage, and Trials
quest.description: Bold Bang Bouldern from the Collective of Plenty seems to be planning some kind of exciting activity with your old friend...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Miss Bold Bang, is your lower back still hurting?

dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: I'm good now... That hot compress worked like a charm!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Heh, to make a hot compress like this, you have to heat the wet bandage with slow-burning gunpowder for just the right amount of time, or you might end up setting it on fire.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Only Yoimiya would come up with a way to warm up bandages like that!

dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: #Hold on a second... Look who's here! Our hero both in name and deed, and {M#his}{F#her} little white companion!

dialogues.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
dialogues.text: Is this the part where a woven scroll comic scene unfolds right in front of me...?

choices.text: Hey! Are you helping patch her up?

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Oh, please don't worry about me! I was just wandering about in the wild, looking for some new tough opponents to practice against.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: Miss Yoimiya here was really a great help to me when I accidentally hurt my back and tumbled down the hill like a snowball!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Heh, to quote The Soulblazer Saga, "I'm merely a warrior who happened to pass by"...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And now, we can make that a "free mercenary"! The Knights have granted me permission to take action and deal with monsters as I see fit.

choices.text: Sounds like there are still monsters lurking, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Things don't look so good... Should we contact the Knights and ask for reinforcements?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: True, we can't afford to be careless, but the situation isn't that urgent yet.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: The Knights have already cleared out the monsters around the International Cross Country Challenge venue, and there are only a few stragglers wandering about at this point.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And honestly, there are quite a few adventurers competing in the challenge who can hold their own anyway.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: They have the strength, skills, and courage. If we treat them like we do the regular folks, they might end up feeling insulted instead.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: So, in line with usual practice at the Adventurers' Guild, we're treating this as a trial, and we've formed a team on the spot to deal with those monsters.

response.speaker: Bold Bang Bouldern
response.text: And that's exactly what the Trial of Valor is about: clearing monsters, emulating various heroes' combat styles, and transcending your own limits!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that's the kind of thinking you'd expect from the Collective of Plenty!

choices.text: Then I definitely want to be a part of this!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: #Awesome! It's been a while since I last saw you in action, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I'm really excited to see your skills now... I wonder, what kind of fireworks can I compare your dazzling moves to?

choices.text: I'm not missing out on this either, that's for sure!
We'll have to act with caution since there are civilians in the area too.
Have you just been through a battle?
